notes: Videos are MuJoCo renders of the simulated robot; no hardware.
Trajectory time bases: path_err 100 Hz (stored here at 10 Hz), real path 10 Hz, planned path 100 Hz (stored at 10 Hz); video clock equals simulation time.
Controller and command names were read from the on-screen HUD of each video.
best_perlin8_nav_trim is the first 24.1 s of best_perlin8_nav (60 s); its plan is a waypoint polyline and not time indexed.
Push schedules (time and force) are not stored with the push videos.

videos.title: Tour on a flat floor
videos.see: robs_c with the outer velocity integral follows a 24.5 s sequence of velocity commands (forward, sideways, turning, stop) on a checkerboard; green is the planned path, red the actual one.
videos.outcome: No fall over 24.5 s; mean path error 0.41 m, max 0.94 m, final 0.08 m.

videos.title: trk_f: scratch policy with a 1 rad/s spin cap
videos.see: The first policy that really tracks speed (ratio 0.98 at 0.5 m/s) runs the standard command sequence, ending with a +2 rad/s spin command above its trained limit.
videos.outcome: Rendered before the video fix described in the study log (the 8 s episode limit silently reset the robot to the start while the commanded path kept going), so treat it as an illustration of behaviour; no trajectory file was stored.

videos.title: trk_g: refined tracking policy
videos.see: trk_g (trk_f continued, action-rate 0.147 to 0.013) runs the standard command sequence including a 1.0 m/s leg.
videos.outcome: Rendered before the video fix described in the study log (the 8 s episode limit silently reset the robot to the start while the commanded path kept going), so treat it as an illustration of behaviour; no trajectory file was stored.

videos.title: lean_c: the lean-reward policy
videos.see: An early policy rewarded for leaning into the command; it balances but moves slowly (ratio about 0.3). Grey floor, no path overlay.
videos.outcome: Rendered before the video fix described in the study log (the 8 s episode limit silently reset the robot to the start while the commanded path kept going), so treat it as an illustration of behaviour; no trajectory file was stored.

videos.title: ballc_freed: first honest on-ball balance
videos.see: After adding the off-ball termination the policy balances on the ball but barely follows commands (ratio 0.21 to 0.33).
videos.outcome: Rendered before the video fix described in the study log (the 8 s episode limit silently reset the robot to the start while the commanded path kept going), so treat it as an illustration of behaviour; no trajectory file was stored.

videos.title: ctrl_free_c: the exploit (void result)
videos.see: With free limits and no off-ball check the policy leaves the ball and stands on its wheels; the tilt check never fires, so the reward looked good. Kept as a warning.
videos.setup: ctrl_free_c_s0; result declared void in the study log
videos.outcome: Result declared void in the study log: the policy leaves the ball within 0.2 to 0.6 s and balances on its wheels.

videos.title: LQR on the square course
videos.see: The model-based LQR drives a square course of 0.5 m/s legs with 1 rad/s turns, 26 s plan; it tracks the 0.5 m/s legs closely.
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 16.3 s (path error 0.68 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.35 m.

videos.title: robs_b + integral on the square course
videos.see: A domain-randomised PPO policy with an outer velocity integral on the square course of 0.5 m/s legs with 1 rad/s turns, 26 s plan.
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 16.6 s (path error 1.28 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.46 m.

videos.title: trk_g on the square, velocity tracking only
videos.see: Pure velocity commands along the square course of 0.5 m/s legs with 1 rad/s turns, 26 s plan; position drift is not corrected.
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 16.2 s (path error 0.78 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.44 m.

videos.title: trk_g on the square, position guidance 1.5
videos.see: The same course with a position-feedback gain of 1.5 1/s toward the planned path (square course of 0.5 m/s legs with 1 rad/s turns, 26 s plan).
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 18.0 s (path error 0.49 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.32 m.

videos.title: trk_h on the square, velocity tracking only
videos.see: The smoother trk_h completes the full course (square course of 0.5 m/s legs with 1 rad/s turns, 26 s plan) without falling but drifts off the planned path.
videos.outcome: No fall over 26.0 s; mean path error 0.58 m, max 1.61 m, final 1.61 m.

videos.title: trk_h on the square, position guidance 1.5
videos.see: Same policy with position guidance; it survives but the path error grows, so position feedback does not fix drift (open problem in the study log).
videos.outcome: No fall over 26.0 s; mean path error 0.63 m, max 2.31 m, final 2.30 m.

videos.title: Pushes during a straight drive (robs_c)
videos.see: The robot drives forward at 0.5 m/s while an on-screen overlay announces pushes in random directions.
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 11.2 s (path error 0.19 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.32 m.

videos.title: Pushes: recovery then a fall (robs_b)
videos.see: robs_b with the integral follows a 0.5 m/s command while being pushed in random directions; the clip ends with a fall.
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 18.0 s (path error 0.17 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.52 m.

videos.title: Pushes during a straight drive (robs_b)
videos.see: A second push run of robs_b on a straight 0.5 m/s drive with random-direction pushes; the clip ends with a fall.
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 11.8 s (path error 0.48 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.39 m.

videos.title: res_c on 8 cm Perlin terrain
videos.see: The residual-on-LQR controller completes the 24.5 s tour on an uneven floor (Perlin amplitude 8 cm, no terrain training).
videos.setup: res_c_s0, tour sequence, Perlin amplitude 0.08 m
videos.outcome: No fall over 24.5 s; mean path error 0.43 m, max 1.21 m, final 0.38 m.

videos.title: res_c on 12 cm Perlin terrain
videos.see: The same controller on a rougher floor (amplitude 12 cm); no fall, path error peaks at 1.2 m.
videos.setup: res_c_s0, tour sequence, Perlin amplitude 0.12 m
videos.outcome: No fall over 24.5 s; mean path error 0.44 m, max 1.22 m, final 0.40 m.

videos.title: LQR on 8 cm Perlin terrain
videos.see: Plain LQR on the same rough floor; it also finishes the tour at 0.5 m/s.
videos.setup: lqr, tour sequence, Perlin amplitude 0.08 m
videos.outcome: No fall over 24.5 s; mean path error 0.40 m, max 1.15 m, final 0.33 m.

videos.title: robs_c on 8 cm Perlin terrain (fails)
videos.see: robs_c with the integral on the 8 cm floor tracks for a while and then leaves the ball while turning at 0.8 rad/s.
videos.setup: robs_c_s0@ki=1.0, tour sequence, Perlin amplitude 0.08 m
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 22.8 s (path error 0.51 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.49 m.

videos.title: robs_c on 12 cm Perlin terrain (fails early)
videos.see: On the 12 cm floor robs_c falls within about 3 s (the terrain evaluation of robs_c covers 4 and 8 cm only).
videos.setup: robs_c_s0@ki=1.0, tour sequence, Perlin amplitude 0.12 m
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 3.1 s (path error 1.05 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.51 m.

videos.title: Waypoint navigation on 8 cm terrain (first 24 s)
videos.see: robs_c is commanded to navigate a list of waypoints at 0.5 m/s on the 8 cm Perlin floor; the clip is the first 24 s of a 60 s run.
videos.setup: robs_c_s0@ki=1.0, nav sequence, Perlin amplitude 0.08 m
videos.outcome: No fall in the first 24 s shown (the full 60 s run also ends without a fall); mean path error over this clip 0.77 m, max 1.92 m.

videos.title: Climbing a 2 cm step (robs_c)
videos.see: Side view: robs_c approaches a 2 cm raised floor at 0.7 m/s, crosses it and stops on top.
videos.outcome: No fall over 6.5 s; mean path error 0.44 m, max 0.79 m, final 0.26 m.

videos.title: A 3 cm step (robs_c fails)
videos.see: Same approach at 3 cm: the robot leaves the ball at the step. The study attributes this limit to wheel-ball traction (friction-scaling tests, 4 trials per cell).
videos.outcome: Falls at t = 3.9 s (path error 0.76 m when it ends); mean path error before the fall 0.38 m.

videos.title: Book study: proprioceptive policy, 2 cm
videos.see: Side view of the book-climbing study with a proprioception-only policy and a 2 cm step.
videos.outcome: The video alone does not show a success or a fall banner. The matching evaluation (outputs/study/results/book2_*.csv, rough-floor amplitude sweep) reports 0 percent goal success for every perception variant at amplitude 1 cm and above.

videos.title: Book study: height-scan policy, 2 cm
videos.see: The same task for a policy that also sees a height scan of the ground ahead (teacher observation).
videos.outcome: The video alone does not show a success or a fall banner. The matching evaluation (outputs/study/results/book2_*.csv, rough-floor amplitude sweep) reports 0 percent goal success for every perception variant at amplitude 1 cm and above.

videos.title: Book study: ToF policy, 2 cm
videos.see: The same task for a policy that sees the simulated 8x8 time-of-flight sensor.
videos.outcome: The video alone does not show a success or a fall banner. The matching evaluation (outputs/study/results/book2_*.csv, rough-floor amplitude sweep) reports 0 percent goal success for every perception variant at amplitude 1 cm and above.

videos.title: Crossing a 2 cm step (cinematic)
videos.see: Side view: the robot drives at 0.7 m/s onto a 2 cm raised floor (shown at 0.5x slow motion). 2 cm step at y = 1 m
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 43.2 cm, max 78.4 cm, final 25.9 cm; max off-ball angle 6.7 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Crossing a 3 cm step (cinematic)
videos.see: Side view: the same approach at 3 cm; the robot loses the ball at the step (shown at 0.5x slow motion). 3 cm step at y = 1 m
videos.outcome: Fell at t = 3.88 s (left the ball). Mean position error 38.0 cm, max 76.9 cm, final 75.8 cm; max off-ball angle 30.8 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Tour on 8 cm Perlin terrain: LQR vs res_c (hybrid) (cinematic)
videos.see: Two controllers on the same scenario and terrain, simulated separately and replayed in sync. Perlin floor, 8 cm amplitude
videos.outcome: LQR: no fall, mean error 40.1 cm, max 116.0 cm; res_c (hybrid): no fall, mean error 42.4 cm, max 120.4 cm Simulation only.

videos.title: Square course: LQR vs robs_b (cinematic)
videos.see: Two controllers on the same scenario and terrain, simulated separately and replayed in sync. flat floor, no relief
videos.outcome: LQR: no fall, mean error 35.5 cm, max 101.8 cm; robs_b: fell at 16.64 s, mean error 45.9 cm, max 127.4 cm Simulation only.

videos.title: Tour on 12 cm Perlin terrain (cinematic)
videos.see: The same controller on a rougher Perlin floor (12 cm amplitude). Perlin floor, 12 cm amplitude
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 43.9 cm, max 121.8 cm, final 40.2 cm; max off-ball angle 18.0 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Waypoint navigation on 8 cm Perlin terrain (cinematic)
videos.see: The robot is steered through numbered waypoints at 0.5 m/s on the 8 cm Perlin floor. Perlin floor, 8 cm amplitude
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 19.1 cm, max 61.3 cm, final 22.4 cm; max off-ball angle 10.6 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Tour on 8 cm Perlin terrain (cinematic)
videos.see: Plain LQR on the same 8 cm Perlin floor and command tour. Perlin floor, 8 cm amplitude
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 40.1 cm, max 116.0 cm, final 33.5 cm; max off-ball angle 13.1 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Tour on 8 cm Perlin terrain (cinematic)
videos.see: Low raking camera on a bumpy Perlin floor (8 cm amplitude, no terrain training). Perlin floor, 8 cm amplitude
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 42.4 cm, max 120.4 cm, final 37.9 cm; max off-ball angle 15.0 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Pushes during a square loop (cinematic)
videos.see: The robot loops a 1.5 m square at 0.5 m/s while pushed in random horizontal directions (30 to 40 N, 0.05 s). flat floor, no relief
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 50.5 cm, max 87.7 cm, final 23.4 cm; max off-ball angle 8.6 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Square course (cinematic)
videos.see: Model-based LQR drives the square course (0.5 m/s legs, one fast leg, one turning leg). flat floor, no relief
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 35.5 cm, max 101.8 cm, final 20.4 cm; max off-ball angle 9.3 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Square course (cinematic)
videos.see: PPO (robs_b + integral) on the same square course. flat floor, no relief
videos.outcome: Fell at t = 16.64 s (left the ball). Mean position error 45.9 cm, max 127.4 cm, final 127.4 cm; max off-ball angle 31.5 deg. Simulation only.

videos.title: Velocity tour on a flat floor (cinematic)
videos.see: Chase camera follows a scripted tour of velocity commands (forward, sideways, diagonal, turning) on a flat floor. flat floor, no relief
videos.outcome: No fall. Mean position error 41.1 cm, max 93.0 cm, final 7.8 cm; max off-ball angle 12.9 deg. Simulation only.
